what_it_does: This work addresses the challenge of running hybrid quantum-classical programs on systems that combine traditional supercomputers (HPC) with quantum processors (QPU). The system lacks proper tools for scheduling jobs across both types of hardware, ensuring code runs the same way on different vendors' equipment, and monitoring what's happening. The paper proposes middleware that acts as a coordinator, sitting on top of existing HPC scheduling systems to direct work to quantum processors, supporting neutral interfaces that work across different quantum vendors, and adding monitoring capabilities to make the system observable and manageable.
